mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", provider_id AS "providerId", provider_kind_type_id AS "providerKindTypeId", display_name AS "displayName", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.provider_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY provider_id

SELECT game_id AS "gameId", provider_id AS "providerId", provider_kind_type_id AS "providerKindTypeId", display_name AS "displayName", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.provider_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.provider_definitions (game_id, provider_id, provider_kind_type_id, display_name, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{providerId}, #{providerKindTypeId}, #{displayName}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, provider_id) DO UPDATE SET provider_kind_type_id = EXCLUDED.provider_kind_type_id, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", provider_id AS "providerId", provider_kind_type_id AS "providerKindTypeId", display_name AS "displayName", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.provider_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, provider_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.provider_definitions_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, provider_id, provider_kind_type_id, display_name ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, provider_id, provider_kind_type_id, display_name FROM public.provider_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, provider_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, provider_kind_type_id = EXCLUDED.provider_kind_type_id, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name
